```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(skimr)
library(janitor)

# CHANGE THIS TO POINT TO WHERE DATASET NAME WAS DEFINED
source("01_packages.R")
source("02_load_data.R")

# CHANGE ONLY THIS LINE
dataset_name <- "df1"

# Pull dataset from your R environment
data <- get(dataset_name)

# Basic checks
stopifnot(is.data.frame(data) || tibble::is_tibble(data))

n_rows <- nrow(data)
n_cols <- ncol(data)
```

# Dataset overview

```{r}
cat("Dataset name:", dataset_name, "\n")
cat("Rows:", n_rows, "\n")
cat("Columns:", n_cols, "\n")
```

# Column names

```{r}
data.frame(
  column_number = seq_along(names(data)),
  column_name = names(data)
)
```


# Summary

```{r}
# Comprehensive variable diagnostics
summarytools::dfSummary(
  data,
  graph.col = FALSE
)
```

# Session information

```{r}
sessionInfo()
```
